extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance plots digitised from Figure 5a, Figure 5b, and Figure 5f. Figure 5e is a literature-comparison plot and was skipped according to the instructions, although it contains this work among literature data. Figure 6 shows TPD/HD-exchange/DRIFTS characterization, not catalytic performance, and was skipped.
